description: Quiet hours (eink-ha-os#295, replaces night mode and the Sleep-at-night power mode). steps/default: the setting's choices. inWindow(hour, window): the window wraps midnight, off never. backAt(window, clock): the quiet face's "Back at {}" time, 12 h like the clock (no AM/PM), '' when off. The face's Tomorrow row (eink-ha-os#328): quiet-tomorrow.json. peekOnBoot(wake): a boot inside the window opens on the dashboard for 60 s unless a timer woke it. Emulator src/core/quiet.ts, firmware src/core/logic.h. The power decision is in power/07-quiet-end.json, the redraw rules in refresh.json, the light in frontlight.json, the settings migration in migrations/07-settings-quiet-hours.json.
